svg.title: Riju preserves one staffed help desk while Vale records the language failure.
svg.desc: A resident's form passes to a human assistant instead of the terminal. Riju proposes one staffed desk through the trial, and Vale limits the exception to seventy-two supervised hours while recording the failure.
svg.text: Page 24, panel 4 · Side medium shot along the staffed assistance desk

text.tspan: Riju keeps one supervised human desk; Vale allows
launch only with the limitation formally recorded.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
